name: Caiuajara
sum: Crested tapejarid from the Early Cretaceous ‘Pterosaur Graveyard’ of Paraná, Brazil, known from hundreds of bones of individuals of all ages.
wsnote: Juveniles from 0.65 m; largest individuals about 2.35 m.
holotype: CP.V 1449 — Goio-Erê Formation (Caiuá Group), Cruzeiro do Oeste, Paraná.
material: Bonebed with hundreds of 3D bones: at least 47 individuals, including 14 partial skulls; holotype is a partial skeleton with skull.
exceptional: Mass-death assemblage documenting growth: the crest grew larger and steeper with age.
biology: The bonebed formed in a lake within a desert; mostly juveniles, possibly a nursery or crèche. Suggests gregarious behaviour. Toothless beak, like other tapejarines.
author: Manzig et al. 2014
